name: Class N Permit (Digital Nomad)

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be a remote employee under contract with a company registered outside Kenya, a foreign company's representative conducting business on its behalf while based in Kenya, or a self-employed professional serving clients located outside Kenya -- the income source, employer, company, or clients must be located outside Kenya.
Requires a no-objection letter from the applicant's home country embassy.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain a no-objection letter from your home country's embassy.

evidence_required.document: Signed cover letter from the employer/company/organization

sources.title: Biz Brokers East Africa (immigration consultancy) -- Kenya Class N Digital Nomad Permit guide: for remote employees of foreign-registered companies, representatives of foreign companies, and self-employed professionals with foreign clients; requires eFNS Form 25, 3 months' bank statements/payslips, employer/company cover letter, accommodation proof in Kenya, embassy no-objection letter; issued for 1-2 years, renewable; no minimum income threshold specified

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kenya). STATUS: DRAFT -- tier-3 sourcing only (a consultancy guide). The Class N permit is unambiguously real and named directly on the Directorate of Immigration Services' own site structure (immigration.go.ke lists Class D, K, N permits as named categories), but this build could not locate the government's own detailed eligibility page for Class N specifically within the time available -- only a consultancy guide (tier 3) was retrieved with requirement-level detail, hence draft rather than published despite the category's confirmed official existence. GENUINE GAP: no minimum income/revenue threshold is specified anywhere located in this build, unusual for a digital-nomad-type route globally (most comparable programs elsewhere set an explicit income floor) -- not invented here. category is work_independent, a category this dataset has built for relatively few countries -- Kenya is a genuine, distinctive addition to that group.
